name: Rodeo Drive / Special Events / Holiday Program Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday
  Program Committee

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, December 7, 2023
  4:00 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  December 7, 2023 / 4:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Lili Bosse, Deputy City
  Manager Kieth Sterling, Special Events Film Coordinator Patricia
  Betancourt, Police Lieutenant Renato Moreno, Consultant for Dick Clark
  Productions Blake Mans, Dick Clark Productions SVP Richard Pizante,
  Dick Clark Productions COO Michael Kohn, Dick Clark Productions EVP
  Barry Adelman, Beverly Hilton Director of Filming and Media Logistics
  Danielle Todd

  1) Public Comment

  Members of the public were given the opportunity to directly address the Committee on
  any item not listed on the agenda.

  None.

  2) Street and Sidewalk Closures Associated with the Golden Globe Award Ceremony
  Scheduled for Sunday, January 7, 2024
  a. Presentation by Patricia Betancourt
  i. Lane and Sidewalk Closures for the 81st Golden Globes will begin on
  Tuesday January 2nd at 6 AM and end on Monday January 8th at 4 AM.
  ii. Local streets north of the Hilton Hotel will be closed between 6 AM Sunday
  January 7th and 4 AM on January 8th.
  iii. Notifications will be distributed to businesses & residents by way of Walking
  Man Services. The closure notifications will include Nixle alerts, Social
  Media posts, and advertisements in local papers. The city will also maintain
  a webpage and hotline that residents can contact for further questions.
  iv. All city expenses related to the Golden Globes are the responsibility of the
  Golden Globes team and will be paid in full prior to the event date. After-
  parties will be billed directly on separate permits.
  b. Notifications will begin following approval for the closures from the City Council on
  Tuesday December 12, 2023
  c. LADOT is aware of the upcoming closures and BHPD is coordinating with LADOT
  concerning the eastbound closure of Wilshire at Comstock. Eastbound traffic will
  be diverted onto Beverly Glen.
 Highlights for December 7, 2023
Rodeo Drive / Special Events / Holiday Program Committee

  3) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: December 7, 2023 / 4:17 PM
